authentication.description: Pass the API key (provided separately) on every request.

conventions.note: Endpoints with optional start/end default to a recent window (usually last 30 days or current month).

GET /kpis.description: Aggregated KPIs for a date range: registrations, active players, betslip counts, stakes, GGR (cash and bonus), hold %, win rate and RFM segment counts.

GET /kpis/latest.description: The most recent day's full KPI row, including a last_updated timestamp (SAST) showing data freshness.

GET /kpis/summary.description: Dashboard-style KPI summary for a period with period-on-period comparison and year-to-date figures.

GET /kpis/daily.description: One KPI row per day in the range. Use 'metrics' (comma-separated column names) to limit the columns returned.

GET /kpis/series.description: Daily series of a single named metric for the last N days.

GET /kpis/rolling.description: Rolling-window KPI series over the requested range.

GET /timeseries/revenue.description: Daily {date, value} points for a revenue metric (default 'ggr').

GET /timeseries/registrations.description: Daily registration counts for the range, filterable by territory/country/status/segment.

GET /timeseries/conversion-cohorts.description: Registration-to-first-deposit conversion rates by registration cohort.

GET /ftd/daily.description: Daily first-time depositor (FTD) counts and values.

GET /ftd-reg-month/daily.description: Daily FTDs attributed to the month the player registered (cohort attribution view).

GET /crm/retention.description: 7/30/90-day player retention rates by cohort month, computed from betting and casino activity.

GET /acquisition/kpis.description: Period-total acquisition KPIs rolled up across all marketing channels.

GET /acquisition/channels.description: Per-channel acquisition breakdown derived from RavenTrack affiliate classification.

GET /acquisition/affiliates.description: Per-affiliate leaderboard table, sortable and limited.

GET /sportsbook/kpis.description: Sportsbook KPIs for the period: stakes, winnings, GGR, hold % and active bettors.

GET /betting/betslips-by-status.description: Betslip counts and stakes split by settlement status (won, lost, open, cancelled, etc.).

GET /betting/betslips-by-type.description: Betslip counts and stakes split by bet type (single, multiple, etc.).

GET /casino/kpis.description: Casino KPIs for the period: stakes, winnings, GGR and active casino players.

GET /casino/daily.description: Daily casino performance, one row per day.

GET /casino/providers.description: Per-game-provider breakdown (e.g. Pragmatic, Evolution, Hacksaw): stake, winnings, bets, GGR.

GET /casino/types.description: Casino performance split by type (Casino vs Live Casino, etc.).

GET /transactions/kpis.description: Payment KPIs for the period: deposits, withdrawals and net cash.

GET /transactions/providers.description: Detailed payment-provider and transaction-reason breakdown plus period totals.

GET /bonus/kpis.description: Bonus totals for the period: issued, converted and expired amounts.

GET /bonus/daily.description: Daily bonus series, one row per day.

GET /bonus/campaigns.description: Bonus campaign list with performance figures, optionally filtered by campaign status.

GET /bonus/freebets.description: Free-bet issuance and usage for the period.

GET /product/daily.description: Daily GGR, turnover and hold % for each product vertical (sportsbook vs casino).

GET /vip/summary.description: Headline VIP counts and revenue for the period.

GET /vip/list.description: VIP roster rows (player, account manager, lifecycle stage, onboard/offboard dates).

GET /vip/revenue.description: Period-active VIP revenue totals (revenue = rolling 30-day figures).

GET /vip/top-players.description: Top VIP players ranked by rolling 30-day turnover.

GET /vip/product-share.description: Aggregate sports vs casino revenue split across current VIPs.

GET /vip/demographics.description: VIP demographics: age-band and country distribution of current VIPs (gender not available in the DWH).

GET /vip/trends.description: 31-day daily NGR/GGR/turnover/margin trend for VIP players.

GET /vip/monthly.description: Six-month VIP performance, one row per calendar month.

GET /vip/hourly.description: Hourly betting-activity pattern for VIP players, aggregated across the selected period.

GET /vip/overview.description: All VIP sections (summary, revenue, managers, top players, trends, etc.) computed in a single response.

GET /rfm/segments.description: Player counts and value per RFM segment (VIP, Active, New, Cooling, Lapsed, Dormant).

GET /rfm/users.description: Individual player rows for an RFM segment; 'columns' limits the fields returned.

GET /rfm/risk.description: Summary of churn-risk tiers (Critical/High/Moderate/Low) across all players.

GET /rfm/risk/players.description: Individual players ordered by churn-risk score (descending), filterable by tier and RFM segment.

params.tier: optional: Critical, High, Moderate or Low

GET /users/self-exclusions/trend.description: Monthly self-exclusion trend: how many started, are active, and completed per month.

GET /health.description: Service status and dataset-availability flags. No API key required.
